annotation.bound_parties_text: The document is a consultation RIS that binds no one, though it considers the role of manufacturers, repairers, registered owners and others in supporting automated vehicle safety.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The Consultation RIS considers the role of manufacturers, repairers, registered owners and others, in supporting the safety of automated vehicles on Australian roads.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: examining the safe operation of automated vehicles on Australian roads
